lines: asmākaṃ tu viśiṣṭā ye tānnibodha dvijottama
nāyakā mama sainyasya saṃjñārthaṃ tānbravīmi te
anye ca bahavaḥ śūrā madarthe tyaktajīvitāḥ
sīdanti mama gātrāṇi mukhaṃ ca pariśuṣyati
na ca śaknomyavasthātuṃ bhramatīva ca me manaḥ
na kāṅkṣe vijayaṃ kṛṣṇa na ca rājyaṃ sukhāni ca
kiṃ no rājyena govinda kiṃ bhogairjīvitena vā
yeṣāmarthe kāṅkṣitaṃ no rājyaṃ bhogāḥ sukhāni ca
ta ime'vasthitā yuddhe prāṇāṃstyaktvā dhanāni ca
api trailokyarājyasya hetoḥ kiṃ nu mahīkṛte
svajanaṃ hi kathaṃ hatvā sukhinaḥ syāma mādhava
aho bata mahatpāpaṃ kartuṃ vyavasitā vayam
klaibyaṃ mā sma gamaḥ pārtha naitattvayyupapadyate

speaker: arjuna uvāca
lines: kathaṃ bhīṣmamahaṃ saṅkhye droṇaṃ ca madhusūdana
gurūnahatvā hi mahānubhāvān śreyo bhoktuṃ bhaikṣamapīha loke
na caitadvidmaḥ kataranno garīyo yadvā jayema yadi vā no jayeyuḥ
yāneva hatvā na jijīviṣāmaste'vasthitāḥ pramukhe dhārtarāṣṭrāḥ
yacchreyaḥ syānniścitaṃ brūhi tanme śiṣyaste'haṃ śādhi māṃ tvāṃ prapannam

speaker: sañjaya uvāca
lines: na yotsya iti govindamuktvā tūṣṇīṃ babhūva ha
natvevāhaṃ jātu nāsaṃ na tvaṃ neme janādhipāḥ
na caiva nabhaviṣyāmaḥ sarve vayamataḥ param
yaṃ hi na vyathayantyete puruṣaṃ puruṣarṣabha
nāsato vidyate bhāvo nābhāvo vidyate sataḥ
avināśi tu tadviddhi yena sarvamidaṃ tatam
ya enaṃ vetti hantāraṃ yaścainaṃ manyate hatam
ubhau tau na vijānīto nāyaṃ hanti na hanyate
na jāyate mriyate vā kadācinnāyaṃ bhūtvā bhavitā vā na bhūyaḥ
ajo nityaḥ śāśvato'yaṃ purāṇo na hanyate hanyamāne śarīre
kathaṃ sa puruṣaḥ pārtha kaṃ ghātayati hanti kam
vāsāṃsi jīrṇāni yathā vihāya navāni gṛhṇāti naro'parāṇi
tathā śarīrāṇi vihāya jīrṇānyanyāni saṃyāti navāni dehī
nainaṃ chindanti śastrāṇi nainaṃ dahati pāvakaḥ
na cainaṃ kledayantyāpo na śoṣayati mārutaḥ
atha cainaṃ nityajātaṃ nityaṃ vā manyase mṛtam
jātasya hi dhruvo mṛtyurdhruvaṃ janma mṛtasya ca
āścaryavaccainamanyaḥ śṛṇoti śrutvā'pyenaṃ veda na caiva kaścit
atha cettvamimaṃ dharmyaṃ saṃgrāmaṃ na kariṣyasi
tataḥ svadharmaṃ kīrtiṃ ca hitvā pāpamavāpsyasi
yeṣāṃ ca tvaṃ bahumato bhūtvā yāsyasi lāghavam
nindantastava sāmarthyaṃ tato duḥkhataraṃ nu kim
hato vā prāpsyasi svargaṃ jitvā vā bhokṣyase mahīm
eṣā te'bhihitā sāṅkhye buddhiryoge tvimāṃ śṛṇu
buddhyā yukto yayā pārtha karmabandhaṃ prahāsyasi
yogasthaḥ kuru karmāṇi saṅgaṃ tyaktvā dhanaṃjaya
siddhyasiddhyoḥ samo bhūtvā samatvaṃ yoga ucyate
karmajaṃ buddhiyuktā hi phalaṃ tyaktvā manīṣiṇaḥ
tadā gantāsi nirvedaṃ śrotavyasya śrutasya ca

speaker: arjuna uvāca
lines: sthitadhīḥ kiṃ prabhāṣeta kimāsīta vrajeta kiṃ
nābhinandati na dveṣṭi tasya prajñā pratiṣṭhitā
tāni sarvāṇi saṃyamya yukta āsīta matparaḥ
vaśe hi yasyendriyāṇi tasya prajñā pratiṣṭhitā
yā niśā sarvabhūtānāṃ tasyāṃ jāgarti saṃyamī
yasyāṃ jāgrati bhūtāni sā niśā paśyato muneḥ
tadvatkāmā yaṃ praviśanti sarve sa śāntimāpnoti na kāmakāmī
eṣā brāhmī sthitiḥ pārtha naināṃ prāpya vimuhyati

speaker: arjuna uvāca
lines: tatkiṃ karmaṇi ghore māṃ niyojayasi keśava
karmendriyāṇi saṃyamya ya āste manasā smaran
niyataṃ kuru karma tvaṃ karma jyāyo hyakarmaṇaḥ
tairdattānapradāyaibhyo yo bhuṅkte stena eva saḥ
bhuñjate te tvaghaṃ pāpā ye pacantyātmakāraṇāt
ātmanyeva ca saṃtuṣṭastasya kāryaṃ na vidyate
na me pārthāsti kartavyaṃ triṣu lokeṣu kiṃcana
yadi hyahaṃ na varteyaṃ jātu karmaṇyatandritaḥ
utsīdeyurime lokā na kuryāṃ karma cedaham
guṇā guṇeṣu vartanta iti matvā na sajjate
prakṛtiṃ yānti bhūtāni nigrahaḥ kiṃ kariṣyati

speaker: arjuna uvāca
lines: atha kena prayukto'yaṃ pāpaṃ carati pūruṣaḥ
manasastu parā buddhiryo buddheḥ paratastu saḥ
sa kāleneha mahatā yogo naṣṭaḥ paraṃtapa
sa evāyaṃ mayā te'dya yogaḥ proktaḥ purātanaḥ
bhakto'si me sakhā ceti rahasyaṃ hyetaduttamam

speaker: arjuna uvāca
lines: aparaṃ bhavato janma paraṃ janma vivasvataḥ

speaker: śrībhagavānuvāca
lines: bahūni me vyatītāni janmāni tava cārjuna
tānyahaṃ veda sarvāṇi na tvaṃ vettha paraṃtapa
yadā yadā hi dharmasya glānirbhavati bhārata
janma karma ca me divyamevaṃ yo vetti tattvataḥ
tyaktvā dehaṃ punarjanma naiti māmeti so'rjuna
ye yathā māṃ prapadyante tāṃstathaiva bhajāmyaham
kāṅkṣantaḥ karmaṇāṃ siddhiṃ yajanta iha devatāḥ
kṣipraṃ hi mānuṣe loke siddhirbhavati karmajā
na māṃ karmāṇi limpanti na me karmaphale spṛhā
iti māṃ yo'bhijānāti karmabhirna sa badhyate
evaṃ jñātvā kṛtaṃ karma pūrvairapi mumukṣubhiḥ
kuru karmaiva tasmāttvaṃ pūrvaiḥ pūrvataraṃ kṛtam
karmaṇo hyapi boddhavyaṃ boddhavyaṃ ca vikarmaṇaḥ
karmaṇyakarma yaḥ paśyedakarmaṇi ca karma yaḥ
samaḥ siddhāvasiddhau ca kṛtvāpi na nibadhyate
brahmaiva tena gantavyaṃ brahma karma samādhinā
evaṃ bahuvidhā yajñā vitatā brahmaṇo mukhe
na hi jñānena sadṛśaṃ pavitramiha vidyate
nāyaṃ loko'sti na paro na sukhaṃ saṃśayātmanaḥ

speaker: arjuna uvāca
lines: saṃnyāsaṃ karmaṇāṃ kṛṣṇa punaryogaṃ ca śaṃsasi
jñeyaḥ sa nityasaṃnyāsī yo na dveṣṭi na kāṅkṣati
ekaṃ sāṅkhyaṃ ca yogaṃ ca yaḥ paśyati sa paśyati
brahmaṇyādhāya karmāṇi saṅgaṃ tyaktvā karoti yaḥ
navadvāre pure dehī naiva kurvanna kārayan
na kartṛtvaṃ na karmāṇi lokasya sṛjati prabhuḥ
nādatte kasya citpāpaṃ na caiva sukṛtaṃ vibhuḥ
śuni caiva śvapāke ca paṇḍitāḥ samadarśinaḥ
ihaiva tairjitaḥ sargo yeṣāṃ sāmye sthitaṃ manaḥ
nirdoṣaṃ hi samaṃ brahma tasmādbrahmaṇi te sthitāḥ
ye hi saṃsparśajā bhogā duḥkhayonaya eva te
ādyantavantaḥ kaunteya na teṣu ramate budhaḥ
kāmakrodhodbhavaṃ vegaṃ sa yuktaḥ sa sukhī naraḥ
vigatecchābhayakrodho yaḥ sadā mukta eva saḥ

speaker: śrībhagavānuvāca
lines: anāśritaḥ karmaphalaṃ kāryaṃ karma karoti yaḥ
sa saṃnyāsī ca yogī ca na niragnirna cākriyaḥ
yaṃ saṃnyāsamiti prāhuryogaṃ taṃ viddhi pāṇḍava
manaḥ saṃyamya maccitto yukta āsīta matparaḥ
yathā dīpo nivātastho neṅgate sopamā smṛtā
vetti yatra na caivāyaṃ sthitaścalati tattvataḥ
yaṃ labdhvā cāparaṃ lābhaṃ manyate nādhikaṃ tataḥ
ātmasaṃsthaṃ manaḥ kṛtvā na kiṃcidapi cintayet
yo māṃ paśyati sarvatra sarvaṃ ca mayi paśyati
tasyāhaṃ na praṇaśyāmi sa ca me na praṇaśyati
sarvathā vartamāno'pi sa yogī mayi vartate
sukhaṃ vā yadi vā duḥkhaṃ sa yogī paramo mataḥ
cañcalaṃ hi manaḥ kṛṣṇa pramāthi balavaddṛḍham

speaker: śrībhagavānuvāca
lines: abhyāsena tu kaunteya vairāgyeṇa ca gṛhyate
asaṃyatātmanā yogo duṣprāpa iti me matiḥ

speaker: arjuna uvāca
lines: aprāpya yogasaṃsiddhiṃ kāṃ gatiṃ kṛṣṇa gacchati
yatate ca tato bhūyaḥ saṃsiddhau kurunandana
śraddhāvānbhajate yo māṃ sa me yuktatamo mataḥ

speaker: śrībhagavānuvāca
lines: asaṃśayaṃ samagraṃ māṃ yathā jñāsyasi tacchṛṇu
bhūmirāpo'nalo vāyuḥ khaṃ mano buddhireva ca
mayi sarvamidaṃ protaṃ sūtre maṇigaṇā iva
praṇavaḥ sarvavedeṣu śabdaḥ khe pauruṣaṃ nṛṣu
puṇyo gandhaḥ pṛthivyāṃ ca tejaścāsmi vibhāvasau
bījaṃ māṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ viddhi pārtha sanātanam
ye caiva sātvikā bhāvā rājasāstāmasāśca ye
matta eveti tānviddhi na tvahaṃ teṣu te mayi
daivī hyeṣā guṇamayī mama māyā duratyayā
māmeva ye prapadyante māyāmetāṃ taranti te
na māṃ duṣkṛtino mūḍhāḥ prapadyante narādhamāḥ
priyo hi jñānino'tyarthamahaṃ sa ca mama priyaḥ
udārāḥ sarva evaite jñānī tvātmaiva me matam
āsthitaḥ sa hi yuktātmā māmevānuttamāṃ gatiṃ
taṃ taṃ niyamamāsthāya prakṛtyā niyatāḥ svayā
yo yo yāṃ yāṃ tanuṃ bhaktaḥ śraddhayārcitumicchati
bhaviṣyāṇi ca bhūtāni māṃ tu veda na kaścana
te brahma tadviduḥ kṛtsnamadhyātmaṃ karma cākhilam
sādhibhūtādhidaivaṃ māṃ sādhiyajñaṃ ca ye viduḥ

speaker: arjuna uvāca
lines: kiṃ tadbrahma kimadhyātmaṃ kiṃ karma puruṣottama
yaḥ prayāti sa madbhāvaṃ yāti nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ
yaṃ yaṃ vāpi smaranbhāvaṃ tyajatyante kalevaram
prayāṇakāle manasā'calena bhaktyā yukto yogabalena caiva
bhruvormadhye prāṇamāveśya samyaksa taṃ paraṃ puruṣamupaiti divyam
yadakṣaraṃ vedavido vadanti viśanti yadyatayo vītarāgāḥ
yadicchanto brahmacaryaṃ caranti tatte padaṃ saṃgraheṇa pravakṣye
sarvadvārāṇi saṃyamya mano hṛdi nirudhya ca
yaḥ prayāti tyajandehaṃ sa yāti paramāṃ gatim
ananyacetāḥ satataṃ yo māṃ smarati nityaśaḥ
māmupetya tu kaunteya punarjanma na vidyate
bhūtagrāmaḥ sa evāyaṃ bhūtvā bhūtvā pralīyate
yaḥ sa sarveṣu bhūteṣu naśyatsu na vinaśyati
yaṃ prāpya na nivartante taddhāma paramaṃ mama
puruṣaḥ sa paraḥ pārtha bhaktyā labhyastvananyayā
prayātā yānti taṃ kālaṃ vakṣyāmi bharatarṣabha
tatra prayātā gacchanti brahma brahmavido janāḥ
śuklakṛṣṇe gatī hyete jagataḥ śāśvate mate
naite sṛtī pārtha jānanyogī muhyati kaścana
vedeṣu yajñeṣu tapaḥsu caiva dāneṣu yatpuṇyaphalaṃ pradiṣṭam
atyeti tatsarvamidaṃ viditvā yogī paraṃ sthānamupaiti cādyam
na ca matsthāni bhūtāni paśya me yogamaiśvaram
na ca māṃ tāni karmāṇi nibadhnanti dhanaṃjaya
vedyaṃ pavitramoṃkāra ṛk sāma yajureva ca
gatirbhartā prabhuḥ sākṣī nivāsaḥ śaraṇaṃ suhṛt
traividyā māṃ somapāḥ pūtapāpā yajñairiṣṭvā svargatiṃ prārthayante
te taṃ bhuktvā svargalokaṃ viśālaṃ kṣīṇe puṇye martyalokaṃ viśanti
ahaṃ hi sarvayajñānāṃ bhoktā ca prabhureva ca
bhūtāni yānti bhūtejyā yānti madyājino'pi mām
patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ toyaṃ yo me bhaktyā prayacchati
samo'haṃ sarvabhūteṣu na me dveṣyo'sti na priyaḥ
ye bhajanti tu māṃ bhaktyā mayi te teṣu cāpyaham
sādhureva sa mantavyaḥ samyagvyavasito hi saḥ
kaunteya pratijānīhi na me bhaktaḥ praṇaśyati
māṃ hi pārtha vyapāśritya ye'pi syuḥ pāpayonayaḥ
striyo vaiśyāstathā śūdrāste'pi yānti parāṃ gatiṃ
manmanā bhava madbhakto madyājī māṃ namaskuru

speaker: śrībhagavānuvāca
lines: bhūya eva mahābāho śṛṇu me paramaṃ vacaḥ
na me viduḥ suragaṇāḥ prabhavaṃ na maharṣayaḥ
sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ bhavo'bhāvo bhayaṃ cābhayameva ca
bhavanti bhāvā bhūtānāṃ matta eva pṛthagvidhāḥ
madbhāvā mānasā jātā yeṣāṃ loka imāḥ prajāḥ
etāṃ vibhūtiṃ yogaṃ ca mama yo vetti tattvataḥ
ahaṃ sarvasya prabhavo mattaḥ sarvaṃ pravartate
iti matvā bhajante māṃ budhā bhāvasamanvitāḥ
kathayantaśca māṃ nityaṃ tuṣyanti ca ramanti ca
dadāmi buddhiyogaṃ taṃ yena māmupayānti te

speaker: arjuna uvāca
lines: paraṃ brahma paraṃ dhāma pavitraṃ paramaṃ bhavān
asito devalo vyāsaḥ svayaṃ caiva bravīṣi me
na hi te bhagavanvyaktiṃ vidurdevā na dānavāḥ
keṣu keṣu ca bhāveṣu cintyo'si bhagavanmayā
bhūyaḥ kathaya tṛptirhi śṛṇvato nāsti me'mṛtam
ahamādiśca madhyaṃ ca bhūtānāmanta eva ca
purodhasāṃ ca mukhyaṃ māṃ viddhi pārtha bṛhaspatim
kīrtiḥ śrīrvākca nārīṇāṃ smṛtirmedhā dhṛtiḥ kṣamā
na tadasti vinā yatsyānmayā bhūtaṃ carācaram
bhavāpyayau hi bhūtānāṃ śrutau vistaraśo mayā
manyase yadi tacchakyaṃ mayā draṣṭumiti prabho

speaker: śrībhagavānuvāca
lines: paśya me pārtha rūpāṇi śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ
na tu māṃ śakyase draṣṭumanenaiva svacakṣuṣā
divyaṃ dadāmi te cakṣuḥ paśya me yogamaiśvaram
yadi bhāḥ sadṛśī sā syādbhāsastasya mahātmanaḥ

speaker: arjuna uvāca
lines: paśyāmi devāṃstava deva dehe sarvāṃstathā bhūtaviśeṣasaṅghān
nāntaṃ na madhyaṃ na punastavādiṃ paśyāmi viśveśvara viśvarūpa
kirīṭinaṃ gadinaṃ cakriṇaṃ ca tejorāśiṃ sarvato dīptimantam
tvamakṣaraṃ paramaṃ veditavyaṃ tvamasya viśvasya paraṃ nidhānam
tvamavyayaḥ śāśvatadharmagoptā sanātanastvaṃ puruṣo mato me
paśyāmi tvāṃ dīptahutāśavaktraṃ svatejasā viśvamidaṃ tapantam
dyāvāpṛthivyoridamantaraṃ hi vyāptaṃ tvayaikena diśaśca sarvāḥ
dṛṣṭvādbhutaṃ rūpamugraṃ tavedaṃ lokatrayaṃ pravyathitaṃ mahātman
amī hi tvā surasaṅghā viśanti kecidbhītāḥ prāñjalayo gṛṇanti
svastītyuktvā maharṣisiddhasaṅghāḥ stuvanti tvāṃ stutibhiḥ puṣkalābhiḥ
rudrādityā vasavo ye ca sādhyā viśve'śvinau marutaścoṣmapāśca
dṛṣṭvā hi tvā pravyathitāntarātmā dhṛtiṃ na vindāmi śamaṃ ca viṣṇo
daṃṣṭrākarālāni ca te mukhāni dṛṣṭvaiva kālānalasannibhāni
diśo na jāne na labhe ca śarma prasīda deveśa jagannivāsa
amī ca tvāṃ dhṛtarāṣṭrasya putrāḥ sarve sahaivāvanipālasaṅghaiḥ
vaktrāṇi te tvaramāṇā viśanti daṃṣṭrākarālāni bhayānakāni
yathā pradīptaṃ jvalanaṃ pataṅgā viśanti nāśāya samṛddhavegāḥ
tathaiva nāśāya viśanti lokāstavāpi vaktrāṇi samṛddhavegāḥ
ākhyāhi me ko bhavānugrarūpo namo'stu te devavara prasīda
vijñātumicchāmi bhavantamādyaṃ na hi prajānāmi tava pravṛttim

speaker: śrībhagavānuvāca
lines: ṛte'pi tvā na bhaviṣyanti sarve ye'vasthitāḥ pratyanīkeṣu yodhāḥ
tasmāttvamuttiṣṭha yaśo labhasva jitvā śatrūnbhuṅkṣva rājyaṃ samṛddham
mayaivaite nihatāḥ pūrvameva nimittamātraṃ bhava savyasācin
droṇaṃ ca bhīṣmaṃ ca jayadrathaṃ ca karṇaṃ tathānyānapi yodhavīrān
mayā hatāṃstvaṃ jahi māvyathiṣṭhā yuddhyasva jetāsi raṇe sapatnān

speaker: sañjaya uvāca
lines: namaskṛtvā bhūya evāha kṛṣṇaṃ sagadgadaṃ bhītabhītaḥ praṇamya

speaker: arjuna uvāca
lines: sthāne hṛṣīkeśa tava prakīrtyā jagatprahṛṣyatyanurajyate ca
rakṣāṃsi bhītāni diśo dravanti sarve namasyanti ca siddhasaṅghāḥ
kasmācca te na nameranmahātman garīyase brahmaṇo'pyādikartre
ananta deveśa jagannivāsa tvamakṣaraṃ sadasattatparaṃ yat
tvamādidevaḥ puruṣaḥ purāṇastvamasya viśvasya paraṃ nidhānam
vettā'si vedyaṃ ca paraṃ ca dhāma tvayā tataṃ viśvamanantarūpa
namo namaste'stu sahasrakṛtvaḥ punaśca bhūyo'pi namo namaste
namaḥ purastādatha pṛṣṭhataste namo'stu te sarvata eva sarva
sakheti matvā prasabhaṃ yaduktaṃ he kṛṣṇa he yādava he sakheti
ajānatā mahimānaṃ tavedaṃ mayā pramādātpraṇayena vā'pi
pitāsi lokasya carācarasya tvamasya pūjyaśca gururgarīyān
piteva putrasya sakheva sakhyuḥ priyaḥ priyāyārhasi deva soḍhum
adṛṣṭapūrvaṃ hṛṣito'smi dṛṣṭvā bhayena ca pravyathitaṃ mano me
tadeva me darśaya deva rūpaṃ prasīda deveśa jagannivāsa
kirīṭinaṃ gadinaṃ cakrahastamicchāmi tvāṃ draṣṭumahaṃ tathaiva
tenaiva rūpeṇa caturbhujena sahasrabāho bhava viśvamūrte

speaker: śrībhagavānuvāca
lines: mayā prasannena tavārjunedaṃ rūpaṃ paraṃ darśitamātmayogāt
tejomayaṃ viśvamanantamādyaṃ yanme tvadanyena na dṛṣṭapūrvam
na vedayajñādhyayanairna dānairna ca kriyābhirna tapobhirugraiḥ
evaṃrūpaḥ śakya ahaṃ nṛloke draṣṭuṃ tvadanyena kurupravīra
mā te vyathā mā ca vimūḍhabhāvo dṛṣṭvā rūpaṃ ghoramīdṛṅmamedam
vyapetabhīḥ prītamanāḥ punastvaṃ tadeva me rūpamidaṃ prapaśya

speaker: sañjaya uvāca
lines: ityarjunaṃ vāsudevastathoktvā svakaṃ rūpaṃ darśayāmāsa bhūyaḥ
āśvāsayāmāsa ca bhītamenaṃ bhūtvā punaḥ saumyavapurmahātmā

speaker: arjuna uvāca
lines: dṛṣṭvedaṃ mānuṣaṃ rūpaṃ tava saumyaṃ janārdana
nāhaṃ vedairna tapasā na dānena na cejyayā
śakya evaṃvidho draṣṭuṃ dṛṣṭavānasi māṃ yathā
jñātuṃ draṣṭuṃ ca tattvena praveṣṭuṃ ca paraṃtapa
nirvairaḥ sarvabhūteṣu yaḥ sa māmeti pāṇḍava

speaker: śrībhagavānuvāca
lines: mayyāveśya mano ye māṃ nityayuktā upāsate
ye tu sarvāṇi karmāṇi mayi saṃnyasya matparāḥ
mayyeva mana ādhatsva mayi buddhiṃ niveśaya
nivasiṣyasi mayyeva ata ūrdhvaṃ na saṃśayaḥ
atha cittaṃ samādhātuṃ na śaknoṣi mayi sthiram
adveṣṭā sarvabhūtānāṃ maitraḥ karuṇa eva ca
mayyarpitamanobuddhiryo me bhaktaḥ sa me priyaḥ
harṣāmarṣabhayodvegairmukto yaḥ sa ca me priyaḥ
sarvārambhaparityāgī yo madbhaktaḥ sa me priyaḥ
yo na hṛṣyati na dveṣṭi na śocati na kāṅkṣati
samaḥ śatrau ca mitre ca tathā mānāpamānayoḥ

speaker: arjuna uvāca
lines: prakṛtiṃ puruṣaṃ caiva kṣetraṃ kṣetrajñameva ca

speaker: śrībhagavānuvāca
lines: etadyo vetti taṃ prāhuḥ kṣetrajña iti tadvidaḥ
kṣetrajñaṃ cāpi māṃ viddhi sarvakṣetreṣu bhārata
tatkṣetraṃ yacca yādṛk ca yadvikāri yataśca yat
sa ca yo yatprabhāvaśca tatsamāsena me śṛṇu
icchā dveṣaḥ sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ saṅghātaścetanā dhṛtiḥ
avibhaktaṃ ca bhūteṣu vibhaktamiva ca sthitam
bhūtabhartṛ ca tajjñeyaṃ grasiṣṇu prabhaviṣṇu ca
jñānaṃ jñeyaṃ jñānagamyaṃ hṛdi sarvasya viṣṭhitam
iti kṣetraṃ tathā jñānaṃ jñeyaṃ coktaṃ samāsataḥ
ya evaṃ vetti puruṣaṃ prakṛtiṃ ca guṇaiḥ saha
na hinastyātmanātmānaṃ tato yāti parāṃ gatiṃ
tata eva ca vistāraṃ brahma saṃpadyate tadā
śarīrastho'pi kaunteya na karoti na lipyate
kṣetraṃ kṣetrī tathā kṛtsnaṃ prakāśayati bhārata
bhūtaprakṛtimokṣaṃ ca ye viduryānti te param

speaker: śrībhagavānuvāca
lines: yajjñātvā munayaḥ sarve parāṃ siddhimito gatāḥ
sarge'pi nopajāyante pralaye na vyathanti ca
satvaṃ sukhe saṃjayati rajaḥ karmaṇi bhārata
rajaḥ satvaṃ tamaścaiva tamaḥ satvaṃ rajastathā
yadā satve pravṛddhe tu pralayaṃ yāti dehabhṛt
satvātsaṃjāyate jñānaṃ rajaso lobha eva ca
ūrdhvaṃ gacchanti satvasthā madhye tiṣṭhanti rājasāḥ

speaker: śrībhagavānuvāca
lines: prakāśaṃ ca pravṛttiṃ ca mohameva ca pāṇḍava
na dveṣṭi saṃpravṛttāni na nivṛttāni kāṅkṣati

speaker: śrībhagavānuvāca
lines: chandāṃsi yasya parṇāni yastaṃ veda sa vedavit
na rūpamasyeha tathopalabhyate nānto na cādirna ca saṃpratiṣṭhā
tataḥ padaṃ tatparimārgitavyaṃ yasmingatā na nivartanti bhūyaḥ
tameva cādyaṃ puruṣaṃ prapadye yataḥ pravṛttiḥ prasṛtā purāṇī
na tadbhāsayate sūryo na śaśāṅko na pāvakaḥ
yadgatvā na nivartante taddhāma paramaṃ mama
śrotraṃ cakṣuḥ sparśanaṃ ca rasanaṃ ghrāṇameva ca
utkrāmantaṃ sthitaṃ vā'pi bhuñjānaṃ vā guṇānvitam
puṣṇāmi cauṣadhīḥ sarvāḥ somo bhūtvā rasātmakaḥ
sarvasya cāhaṃ hṛdi sanniviṣṭo mattaḥ smṛtirjñānamapohanaṃ ca
dvāvimau puruṣau loke kṣaraścākṣara eva ca
ato'smi loke vede ca prathitaḥ puruṣottamaḥ
dvau bhūtasargau loke'smindaiva āsura eva ca
daivo vistaraśaḥ prokta āsuraṃ pārtha me śṛṇu
pravṛttiṃ ca nivṛttiṃ ca janā na vidurāsurāḥ
na śaucaṃ nāpi cācāro na satyaṃ teṣu vidyate
ahaṅkāraṃ balaṃ darpaṃ kāmaṃ krodhaṃ ca saṃśritāḥ
na sa siddhimavāpnoti na sukhaṃ na parāṃ gatim

speaker: arjuna uvāca
lines: teṣāṃ niṣṭhā tu kā kṛṣṇa satvamāho rajastamaḥ

speaker: śrībhagavānuvāca
lines: trividhā bhavati śraddhā dehināṃ sā svabhāvajā
sātvikī rājasī caiva tāmasī ceti tāṃ śṛṇu
śraddhāmayo'yaṃ puruṣo yo yacchraddhaḥ sa eva saḥ
aśāstravihitaṃ ghoraṃ tapyante ye tapo janāḥ
yātayāmaṃ gatarasaṃ pūti paryuṣitaṃ ca yat
abhisaṃdhāya tu phalaṃ dambhārthamapi caiva yat
ijyate bharataśreṣṭha taṃ yajñaṃ viddhi rājasam
anudvegakaraṃ vākyaṃ satyaṃ priyahitaṃ ca yat
deśe kāle ca pātre ca taddānaṃ sātvikaṃ smṛtam
dīyate ca parikliṣṭaṃ taddānaṃ rājasaṃ smṛtam
praśaste karmaṇi tathā sacchabdaḥ pārtha yujyate
yajñe tapasi dāne ca sthitiḥ saditi cocyate
aśraddhayā hutaṃ dattaṃ tapastaptaṃ kṛtaṃ ca yat
asadityucyate pārtha na ca tatpretya no iha

speaker: śrībhagavānuvāca
lines: kāmyānāṃ karmaṇāṃ nyāsaṃ saṃnyāsaṃ kavayo viduḥ
niścayaṃ śṛṇu me tatra tyāge bharatasattama
etānyapi tu karmāṇi saṅgaṃ tyaktvā phalāni ca
sa kṛtvā rājasaṃ tyāgaṃ naiva tyāgaphalaṃ labhet
saṅgaṃ tyaktvā phalaṃ caiva sa tyāgaḥ sātviko mataḥ
na hi dehabhṛtā śakyaṃ tyaktuṃ karmāṇyaśeṣataḥ
aniṣṭamiṣṭaṃ miśraṃ ca trividhaṃ karmaṇaḥ phalam
bhavatyatyāgināṃ pretya na tu saṃnyāsināṃ kvacit
adhiṣṭhānaṃ tathā kartā karaṇaṃ ca pṛthagvidham
nyāyyaṃ vā viparītaṃ vā pañcaite tasya hetavaḥ
tatraivaṃ sati kartāramātmānaṃ kevalaṃ tu yaḥ
yasya nāhaṃkṛto bhāvo buddhiryasya na lipyate
hatvā'pi sa imām̐llokānna hanti na nibadhyate
jñānaṃ karma ca kartā ca tridhaiva guṇabhedataḥ
vetti sarveṣu bhūteṣu tajjñānaṃ viddhi rājasam
yattu kāmepsunā karma sāhaṅkāreṇa vā punaḥ
viṣādī dīrghasūtrī ca kartā tāmasa ucyate
pravṛttiṃ ca nivṛttiṃ ca kāryākārye bhayābhaye
bandhaṃ mokṣaṃ ca yā vetti buddhiḥ sā pārtha sātvikī
yayā dharmamadharmaṃ ca kāryaṃ cākāryameva ca
prasaṅgena phalākāṅkṣī dhṛtiḥ sā pārtha rājasī
yayā svapnaṃ bhayaṃ śokaṃ viṣādaṃ madameva ca
na vimuñcati durmedhā dhṛtiḥ sā pārtha tāmasī
sukhaṃ tvidānīṃ trividhaṃ śṛṇu me bharatarṣabha
na tadasti pṛthivyāṃ vā divi deveṣu vā punaḥ
sve sve karmaṇyabhirataḥ saṃsiddhiṃ labhate naraḥ
sahajaṃ karma kaunteya sadoṣamapi na tyajet
siddhiṃ prāpto yathā brahma tathā''pnoti nibodha me
samāsenaiva kaunteya niṣṭhā jñānasya yā parā
buddhyā viśuddhayā yukto dhṛtyā''tmānaṃ niyamya ca
ahaṅkāraṃ balaṃ darpaṃ kāmaṃ krodhaṃ parigraham
brahmabhūtaḥ prasannātmā na śocati na kāṅkṣati
samaḥ sarveṣu bhūteṣu madbhaktiṃ labhate parām
tato māṃ tattvato jñātvā viśate tadanantaram
sarvaguhyatamaṃ bhūyaḥ śṛṇu me paramaṃ vacaḥ
iṣṭo'si me dṛḍhamiti tato vakṣyāmi te hitam
manmanā bhava madbhakto madyājī māṃ namaskuru
māmevaiṣyasi satyaṃ te pratijāne priyo'si me
ahaṃ tvā sarvapāpebhyo mokṣayiṣyāmi mā śucaḥ
na cāśuśrūṣave vācyaṃ na ca māṃ yo'bhyasūyati
bhavitā na ca me tasmādanyaḥ priyataro bhuvi
adhyeṣyate ca ya imaṃ dharmyaṃ saṃvādamāvayoḥ
vismayo me mahānrājanhṛṣyāmi ca punaḥ punaḥ
yatra yogeśvaraḥ kṛṣṇo yatra pārtho dhanurdharaḥ
